item.hollowvigil.sanity_charm.desc: Right-click to calm your mind (+30 sanity). While in your inventory, sanity drains slower.
item.hollowvigil.hollow_heart.desc: Eating it fully restores your sanity.
item.hollowvigil.hollow_lantern.desc: Held in hand it wards off fear: sanity rises fast, even in total darkness.
item.hollowvigil.killer_knife.desc: Only one who lost all honor can wound the entities with it.
hollow.welcome: [Hollow Vigil] Mod loaded. Something will watch you soon. (Test: /hollow scare @s - needs cheats)
hollow.madness.start: The walls are breathing. They are real now.
hollow.sinner.warn: Something old now counts your sins.
hollow.honored.notice: A calm presence now watches over you.
hollow.killer.title: KILLER
hollow.killer.subtitle: Your honor is gone. Kill every entity.
hollow.killer.msg.1: Your honor reached zero. You fear nothing now.
hollow.killer.msg.2: Mission: eliminate the entities. Only you can hurt them now.
hollow.killer.msg.3: A knife was placed in your hands. Your health and strength grew.
hollow.killer.done.title: ABSOLVED
hollow.killer.done.subtitle: The hunt is over. Your honor is reborn.
hollow.killer.done.msg: The entities fell silent. You regained some honor.
hollow.angel.title: ANGEL
hollow.angel.subtitle: Perfect honor. No entity will find you.
hollow.angel.msg: Wings of light hold you up. The creatures feel your warmth and the entities will never appear to you again.
hollow.angel.fall: The light went out. You are mortal again.
